about: Hand-curated venue research for MarxismNL Conference, keyed by the code the pretalx adapter gives each building. Every figure is {value, source}; coordinates carry the basis they rest on.

iish.name: International Institute of Social History

coordinates.basis: OpenStreetMap's Internationaal Instituut voor Sociale Geschiedenis (node 1386072785)

iish.notes: The conference page places the conference at the IISH; its four panel rooms are the schedule's Nettlau, Posthumus, Scheltema and Nikolaevsky rooms.

iire.name: IIRE
iire.notes: The International Institute for Research and Education, where the schedule holds the three evening keynote panels; its address is the one marxism-nl.org gives for its other IIRE events.
